confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Thai resort-island pricing, not checked against live listings. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain because July low-season rates vary widely by area and season. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (roughly 2x and 2.4x beer) because direct recall of ordinary-venue prices is weaker. FX: the 13 Oct 2026 4pm RBA figure comes from search summaries that attribute it to the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not open that page directly, and a 14 Oct 2026 value could not be confirmed, so the FX date may lag by one business day.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Regional basis: Thai island-resort price levels (loosely similar to Krabi and Koh Samui), using ordinary local venues rather than tourist-strip prices and July low-season accommodation rates.
